class.name: E3DRenderingServer
class.brief_description: RID based server of E3D model instances.
class.description: Singleton with an API similar to [RenderingServer]. An instance is created with [method instance_create], set up with the [code]instance_set_*[/code] methods and [method instance_attach_node], and built with [method instance_build]. The [enum Instancer] of an instance selects how it is built: [constant INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] renders every submodel as a [RenderingServer] instance without creating any nodes (used for scenery models), [constant INSTANCER_NODES] and [constant INSTANCER_EDITABLE_NODES] build a [Node3D]/[MeshInstance3D]/[SpotLight3D] tree under the attached node. [code]E3DModelInstance[/code] is a node client of this server. [RenderingServer] instances are freed when the singleton is deleted. Scenery placements are registered with [method instance_register] instead: [SceneryStreamingServer] builds them only while its camera is within their visibility range of the chunk they fall into, and clears them again when it leaves.

method.name: get_smoke_statistics
method.description: Number of particle emitters the server owns ([code]total[/code]) and how many of them are currently built ([code]built[/code]). A scenery emitter is built only while it is streamed in.

method.name: instance_attach_node
method.description: [constant INSTANCER_NODES] and [constant INSTANCER_EDITABLE_NODES] build their node tree under [param node]. [constant INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instances report [param node] as their owner (e.g. for picking in the editor). Rebuilds an already built instance.

method.name: instance_build
method.description: Builds (or rebuilds) the content of the [param instance]. Materials are resolved with the callable set by [method set_material_resolver].

method.name: instance_create
method.description: Creates an empty instance of the [param model]. It is rendered after [method instance_build].

method.name: instance_free
method.description: Frees the [param instance] with its [RenderingServer] instances or generated nodes.

method.name: instance_register
method.description: Registers a scenery model placement for streaming instead of building it right away. Nothing is loaded or built until [SceneryStreamingServer]'s camera comes within [param range_end] of the chunk the [param transform] falls into; the instance is cleared again when the camera leaves. [param range_end] of [code]0[/code] (a scenery node that declares no range) means the global draw distance. The model is loaded on the streaming worker thread with the callable set by [method set_model_loader]. Without a streaming camera a registered instance is never built. Free it with [method instance_free] like any other instance.

method.name: instance_set_layer_mask
method.description: Render layers of an [constant INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instance.

method.name: instance_set_lights_state
method.description: Light name to enabled state; shows the "on" or the "off" submodels of the model's lights (and the spotlights of [constant INSTANCER_NODES]).

method.name: instance_set_options
method.description: Material lookup path and skins, submodels excluded from rendering and forced alpha blending (see [code]E3DModelInstance[/code]). Rebuilds an already built instance.

method.name: instance_set_scenario
method.description: Scenario of an [constant INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instance. Rebuilds an already built instance.

method.name: instance_set_smoke_state
method.description: Spawn rate multiplier and opacity of every particle emitter of the instance, as the engine state drives them. Both default to [code]1.0[/code], which is the emitter template's own rate - what a scenery chimney keeps.

method.name: instance_set_transform
method.description: Global transform of an [constant INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instance. A node tree follows its attached node instead.

method.name: instance_set_visibility_range
method.description: Limits the visibility range of all submodels of an [constant INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instance, [code]0[/code] - no limit. Rebuilds an already built instance.

method.name: instance_set_visible
method.description: Visibility of an [constant INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instance.

method.name: set_material_resolver
method.description: Called as [code]material_resolver(submodel: E3DSubModel, data_path: String, skins: PackedStringArray, force_alpha: bool) -> Material[/code] for every rendered submodel. Set by [code]MaterialManager[/code].

method.name: set_model_loader
method.description: Called as [code]model_loader(data_path: String, filename: String) -> E3DModel[/code] on the streaming worker thread, for instances registered with [method instance_register] that enter the camera's range. The result is memoized per path. Set by [code]E3DModelManager[/code].

method.name: set_smoke_source_resolver
method.description: Called as [code]smoke_source_resolver(template_name: String) -> Dictionary[/code] with the keys [code]process_material[/code], [code]mesh[/code], [code]amount[/code], [code]lifetime[/code] and [code]aabb[/code], when an emitter is built. An empty dictionary leaves the emitter unbuilt. Set by [code]SmokeSourceLibrary[/code], which reads the templates from the game's [code]data/[/code] directory.

method.name: set_wind
method.description: The wind every particle emitter drifts with: [param strength] in metres per second along the unit [param direction]. Separate so that the direction can grow a vertical component without the signature changing. Pushed by [code]MaszynaEnvironmentNode[/code] together with the time of day and the light level.

method.name: set_wind_direction
method.description: Direction the wind blows along, without touching its strength. Normalized by the server; horizontal today, but a vertical component needs no API change.

method.name: set_wind_strength
method.description: Wind speed in metres per second, without touching its direction.

constants.constant: Renders submodels as [RenderingServer] instances, without nodes.
Builds an internal node tree under the attached node.
Builds a node tree under the attached node, editable in the editor.
